source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computed tomography (PDF 52-53).

blocks.text: CT scan X-rays aur computer ki madad se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli tasveerein banata hai. Is ka usool yeh hai ke mukhtalif tissues X-rays ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain, aur yahi farq tasveer banata hai.

items: Tareeqa: mareez motor wali mez par letta hai jo doughnut-numa machine, gantry, mein khisakti hai. Gantry mein X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti aur saamne ke detectors record karte hain ke har tissue se kitni X-ray guzri. Computer is se tafseeli tarash wali tasveer banata hai.
Istemal: dimagh, phephron aur pait jaise naram tissues ki tasveer, aur haddi ki kharabi dhoondna; cancers, infections aur choton ki tashkhees.

blocks.alt: Teen panel. EEG: sar ki jild par electrodes jo amplifier se jure hain, aur paanch lehrein gamma, beta, alpha, theta aur delta, tez se aahista. CT: mez par mareez ke gird chhalla-numa gantry, oopar X-ray tube jo mareez ke gird ghoomti aur saamne detectors. MRI: mez par mareez ke gird taqatwar magnet wala tube-numa scanner, aur radio waves jo hydrogen atoms se signal dilwati hain.
blocks.caption: Computed tomography scan (Figure 15.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: EEG dimagh ki barqi sargarmi record karta hai: sar par electrodes signal pakarte, amplifier unhein bara karta aur woh lehron ki shakal mein dikhte hain; yeh bila dard hai aur dauron, mirgi aur rasolion ke liye istemal hota hai. CT scan mareez ke gird ghoomti tube se X-rays bhejta hai; detectors naapte hain ke har tissue kitna jazb karta hai aur computer tarash wali tasveerein banata hai. MRI taqatwar magnetic field aur radio waves istemal karta hai: tissues ke hydrogen atoms signal dete hain jinhein computer tafseeli teen-jihati tasveeron mein badalta hai, khaas kar dimagh aur spinal cord jaise naram tissues ki.

blocks.prompt: CT tasveer mein mukhtalif tissues mukhtalif kyun dikhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh X-rays ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain; detectors yeh naapte aur computer farq ko tasveer mein badalta hai.

items: CT: gantry mein ghoomti X-ray tube, detectors jazb naapte, computer tarashein banata; dimagh, phephre, pait, haddi.
